# Things That Hunt
The Colossus sector kills people. Most of it is ordinary: vacuum, hunger, a pirate with a cannon. Some of it is not.
This chapter is about the things that are not.
- [textlink="Chimera" link="WFLoreChimera"]: the living flesh of Carcinoma, once turned loose on Aerumna. - [textlink="Xenonids" link="WFLoreXenonids"]: the hives under Aerumna.
Some of what hunts out past the anchors is kept in [textlink="Forbidden" link="WFLoreForbidden"].
